articles.title: Constructive Alignment: Governing Preference Dynamics in Human-AI Interaction
articles.summary: arXiv:2607.00001v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Most approaches to AI alignment treat human preferences as fixed targets to be inferred and optimized. articles.title: Bounded Morality: Defining the Space of Moral Computation
articles.summary: arXiv:2607.00002v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Moral cognition has traditionally been modeled as adherence to fixed ethical theories--deontology, consequentialism, virtue ethics--implemented as static rules or value functions. We propose Bounded Morality, a formal framework for analyzing the computational demands of moral problems faced by finite agents.
